title: Composition of constant pullback comparisons
statement: For schemes P,U,V [def-pc-scheme], h:U→P, v:V→U and A in Type (u+1), let gamma be [def-weil-pbc-etale-set-constant-pullback-comparison] and let c be the chosen comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Then gamma_v(A) inverse followed by L_v(gamma_h(A) inverse) followed by c_{h,v}(C_P(A)) equals gamma_{v composed with h}(A) inverse. Here C is [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

proof.text: Compare these two maps from C_V(A) using injectivity of the constant-sheaf adjunction with terminal sections. On a generator at the terminal object, apply the unit-generator identity to each inverse constant comparison. Naturality allows movement past the terminal-object comparison isomorphisms.

The section formula of the chosen c replaces the two successive units by the composite unit restricted along the canonical fibre-product comparison. Both the fibre-product pasting and terminal-object comparisons preserve the unique map to the terminal object. Naturality and the composite unit-generator identity identify this generator with gamma for v composed with h inverse. Equality on generators gives the same function on A at terminal sections, and the constant-sheaf adjunction gives equality of sheaf maps.
